title: UndoBar text and icon use reversed theme colors instead of TextItem colors
scope: Selected, implemented and resolved on 2026-11-04. User confirmed the change works and requested closure and commit.
report: UndoBar text and icon should follow TextItem's color. They are currently black on Dark theme and white on Light theme; they should be the opposite.
environment: Original report did not specify a device/build. Independently reproduced with the production View/UndoBar in native Windows rendering, Qt 6.12.0 MSVC 2022 x64.
reproduction_status: Reproduced in both Light and Dark themes before the fix. The automated foreground comparison fails with the reported reversed colors.
reproduction: Select Dark theme and delete an item to display UndoBar.
Compare the message and Undo icon foregrounds with normal TextItem text.
actual: User reports black text and icon in Dark theme and white text and icon in Light theme.
expected: UndoBar message and icon follow normal TextItem foreground colors: light in Dark theme and dark in Light theme, including the effective palette when System is selected.
source_notes: Confirmed cause: app/UndoBar.qml applies Theme.inverseTheme to the popup. The message's inherited Material Label foreground and the TextIcon's Material.foreground therefore select the opposite palette from normal list text.
app/TextItem.qml uses Material.primaryTextColor for normal unchecked text and Material.backgroundColor for checked text. The requested reference is normal TextItem text.
acceptance_criteria: Independently reproduce and record the foreground mismatch in Light and Dark themes.
Both message and icon match normal TextItem theme colors, including live theme changes and System resolved to Light or Dark.
Preserve full-opacity text/icon readability over the progress fill and uncovered background, countdown, whole-bar Undo and deletion batching.

Add an automated regression exercising the production component and rendered theme colors; demonstrate failure before the fix and success afterward. Record native rendering coverage and any Android-specific verification gap.

implementation.change: Bind both message and icon color directly to Theme.Material.primaryTextColor, matching normal TextItem text independently of the popup's inverse surface palette. Background, transparency, accent fill, timing and interaction behavior are unchanged.
implementation.before: Both rows fail on the original component: Light message actual #ffffff versus TextItem #dd000000; Dark message actual #dd000000 versus TextItem #ffffff. See out/ui024/before-windows.txt.
implementation.after: All ten native rendering records pass, including foreground equality with a production TextItem and actual message/icon glyph pixels over full and empty progress backgrounds. Live Light/Dark/System changes are tested while the popup stays open. See out/ui024/after-windows.txt.
implementation.windows_verification: Windows configure/build passes. Main UI (200), desktop keyboard (6), model (98) and native rendering (10) records pass. The initial flow run passed 18/19, failing test_mode_pull_threshold; its focused recheck and full 19-record flow-suite rerun pass without code changes. Logs: out/ui024/windows-build.log, windows-tests.log, mode-pull-recheck.txt and flow-recheck.log. Total current passing records: 333; the first full run was not a clean pass.
implementation.package_verification: Signed ARM64 Debug APK passes tests/test_android_package.py: 45 native libraries, no QML tooling, complete native dependency closure and app-only scan roots. Signing certificate matches the shared debug key. Evidence: out/ui024/arm64-package.json and signature.txt.
implementation.format: All 57 tracked QML/templates pass tools/format-qml.ps1 -Check; git diff --check passes.
implementation.test_note: The new pixel cases use preview scale 2 so font antialiasing leaves fully covered glyph pixels; the existing fill cases retain scale 1 and 2 coverage. The test scene inherits Theme.theme like the application window.
implementation.validation_gap: System uses the current Windows system palette; both OS schemes have not been forced separately. Automated native Android rendering was not run for UI-024. User confirmed the change works; device and theme matrix were not specified.

resolution.acceptance: User: Seems to work, Close ticket and commit.
resolution.change: UndoBar message and icon follow normal TextItem foreground colors while retaining the accepted inverse surface and progress treatment.
resolution.regression: The Light-first and Dark-first native rendering cases fail before the fix and pass afterward; test location and verification details are recorded above.
resolution.remaining: No remaining work in the accepted color-fix scope. Automated Android rendering and independently forced OS color schemes retain the documented coverage limits.
